items.summary: Recommendation: reject the dumbsluts.com readiness baseline because the available snapshot and completed public inspection already cover the proposed evidence, while analytics, traffic, revenue, attribution, and operational health remain unknown. Approve only three normal-priority metadata-only routing repairs for 0daynews.com, amputeenews.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. No production, credential, configuration, spending, schedule, duplicate-telemetry, unsupported revenue, or causal-lift work is authorized.
